CBI arrests defence firm executive director in bribery case

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested the Executive Director of a state-owned defence firm, along with the CEO of a private company, SMPP. The arrests are reportedly related to a bribery case involving the leak of sensitive information. The Executive Director's brother was also arrested.
